meta_description:
13K likes, 103 comments - thefitnesschef_ on October 12, 2026: "Here’s how to make this protein packed breakfast wrap 👀⬇️

Ingredients (serves 2)
20ml olive oil
200g thinly sliced potatoes
4 eggs, whisked 
2 slices tomatoes 
Tortilla wrap
60g grated mozzarella 
80g wafer ham

Method:
1. Add potatoes to boiling water and simmer for 10-15 mins to part boil, then set aside to cool before thinly slicing 
2. Add the olive oil to a preheated pan, then add the potato slices and fry each side for 2-3 mins until crispy 
3. Add the tomato slices on top of the potatoes before adding the whisked eggs, followed by the tortilla 
4. Using a spatula, gently fold over to flip the omelette 
5. Add the mozzarella and ham, gently folding over and cooking for a further 2-3 mins until the mozzarella melts 

Nutrition (per serving)
Calories: 498
Protein: 31g
Carbs: 44g
Fat: 22g

Original creator: @pembissunumlarim 

#breakfast #omelette #recipeoftheday".
